copy.description: This elevated feeder stand is made for your pet's food or water. The stand tilts at 15 degrees in an elevated design. The stand is built from ABS, PC, and plastic. The bowl and base come apart, and the set is washable, portable, and easy to clean. It suits dogs, cats, puppies, and other small animals. Each order includes one base stand and one or two bowls, depending on the version. Shipping comes from a US warehouse. If you are a pet parent who wants a raised feeder, this one is worth a look. Keep the bowl and base clean between meals, and wipe down the stand as needed. Each version lists its own setup, so pick the bowl layout that fits your feeding spot.

faq.q: Does it come with one bowl or two?
faq.a: It includes one base stand and either one or two bowls, depending on the version.
The bowl and base come apart, and the set is washable, portable, and easy to clean.
